snippet.title: Playrooms - Release Date Trailer | Clean the Backrooms before the lights go out
snippet.description:
Playrooms is a first-person cleaning game set in the Backrooms: collect nearly 200,000 balls, bring them back to the ball pits and upgrade your tools! From your bare hands to shovels, vacuums and a whole fleet of robot vacuums.

Just make sure you're back before the lights go out.

📅 Release: October 28, 2026
👉 Wishlist on Steam ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/5037510/Playrooms/

Every wishlist helps us a lot. Thanks for watching!
